items.name: Adult Menu
items.description: Pumpkin velouté with pan-fried shiitake mushrooms and pumpkin seeds (vegan), smoked salmon and spinach roll or duck pâté en croûte with apricot and ginger; beef parmentier, garden herb salad, full-bodied truffle sauce, prawn risotto with garden peas and a Parmesan crisp, roasted chicken breast, morel sauce, baby potatoes with sage, or soft chickpea patty (vegan); Cinderella's dessert, warm cocoa fondant, soya and almond syrup emulsion, soya and pistachio cream (vegan), or seasonal fruit in a lemon and lemon verbena jelly, red fruit soup. Wine included: IGP Pays d'Oc Cité de Carcassonne - Gérard Bertrand, IGP Cité de Carcassonne - Gérard Bertrand - Merlot or AOP Côtes de Provence - Minuty - Prestige rosé 10 cl; AOC Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Nuits - Pierre Maizière, AOC Chablis - La Pierrelée - La Chablisienne or wine of the moment 10 cl; Edition Spéciale Disneyland® Paris - Champagne Pierre Mignon Grande Réserve - brut 10 cl

items.name: Kids' Menu
items.description: For children ages 3 to 11. Fairy canapé: cream of pumpkin soup with Kiri® cheese and pumpkin seed open sandwich, or smoked salmon rolled with Kiri® cheese; thyme chicken, tropical sole fillet or pasta with vegetables (veggie); Cinderella's surprise or red fruit soup with light whipped vanilla cream; Vittel® 33 cl, orange or apple juice 25 cl or milk 20 cl. A different soft drink (25 cl) may replace a similar item on request
